action_items: Fix Dashboard Leaflet mount issue. Common fixes: (a) give <MapContainer> a stable `key` and wrap in a component that mounts once, (b) disable React.StrictMode in src/index.js for now, or (c) use useRef + effect cleanup to destroy the map instance on unmount. react-leaflet 4.2.1 has known StrictMode double-mount issues on React 19 — consider react-leaflet@^5 (React 19 compatible) or the workaround pattern of rendering MapContainer only after a mounted flag flips true in useEffect.
